cards.meaning: restraint or containment — taking action to stop something before it escalates or gets worse
cards.example: Naglagay ang pulisya ng dagdag na tauhan bilang pagpigil sa posibleng karahasan.
cards.exampleMeaning: Police deployed additional personnel as a containment measure against possible violence.
cards.note: Distinct from 'pagbabawal' (a formal ban or prohibition) — 'pagpigil' is about the physical/procedural act of preventing escalation, not a legal rule declaring something forbidden.
cards.tiesTo: 17,000+ police on alert and Malacañang locked down for the martial law anniversary rally

cards.meaning: detention or imprisonment — the state of being held in custody, typically while awaiting trial or a hearing
cards.example: Nanatili sa pagkakakulong ang dating pangulo habang naghihintay ng pagsisimula ng kanyang paglilitis.
cards.exampleMeaning: The former president remained in detention while awaiting the start of his trial.
cards.note: More specific than 'pagkabihag' (captivity in general — war, accident, or any non-legal circumstance) — 'pagkakakulong' refers specifically to official, legal custody under a court order or case.
cards.tiesTo: Duterte's ICC judges denying release and confirming a November 30 trial date

cards.meaning: "not hesitate to (even at real cost)" — a formal adverb signaling strong, even reckless, commitment
cards.example: 一些地方政府不惜代价维持土地财政，即使收入已经大幅下降。
cards.examplePinyin: Yìxiē dìfāng zhèngfǔ bùxī dàijià wéichí tǔdì cáizhèng, jíshǐ shōurù yǐjīng dàfú xiàjiàng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Some local governments won't hesitate to pay any cost to keep relying on land revenue, even as that revenue has fallen sharply.
cards.note: Register: 书面语 (formal, written). Almost always paired with a cost word — 不惜代价 ("at any cost") or 不惜一切 ("at all costs") — signaling commitment strong enough to disregard the price, not casual willingness.
cards.tiesTo: Local governments still leaning on land-dependent financing as land-sale revenue keeps falling

cards.meaning: "to weigh up" (pros and cons) before a decision — a formal verb for deliberate trade-off analysis
cards.example: 北京必须权衡利弊，决定是继续收紧预售政策，还是放松以稳住地方财政。
cards.examplePinyin: Běijīng bìxū quánhéng lìbì, juédìng shì jìxù shōujǐn yùshòu zhèngcè, háishi fàngsōng yǐ wěnzhù dìfāng cáizhèng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Beijing has to weigh the pros and cons of whether to keep tightening presale policy or ease up to stabilize local government finances.
cards.note: Register: 书面语 (formal, policy/finance writing). Abstract collocation verb, not a connective — pairs with 利弊 ("pros and cons") as 权衡利弊, or 得失 ("gains and losses") as 权衡得失, both set phrases common in financial commentary.
cards.tiesTo: Beijing weighing whether to keep tightening presale rules or ease them to protect local government revenue
